newsitem.title: YEMEN: U.S. warship on first visit to Aden in 30 years.
newsitem.headline: U.S. warship on first visit to Aden in 30 years.

text.p: The United States frigate Halyburton docked at the southern Yemeni port of Aden on Monday on the first visit to the harbour by a U.S. warship in 30 years, officials said.
The U.S. embassy said in a statement the guided-missile frigate's "friendly call" on Aden was part of a regional tour.
The warship arrived from Bahrain and its 250 crew would carry out humanitarian work in the impoverished city such as painting walls of charitable societies and schools, it said.

Aden was designated as the economic and commercial capital of the unified country after a 1990 agreement on the merger between the once royalist Yemen Arab Republic in the north and the Marxist People's Democratic Republic of the Yemen in the south.
